info.name: Treasury Fiscal Data Exchange Rates Treasury Statements API
Treasury Fiscal Data Get Daily Treasury Statement

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use to limit output to specific columns (e.g., fields=record_date,tot_pub_debt_out_amt).

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter criteria using format field:operator:value. Multiple filters separated by commas. Operators: eq (equals), lt (less than), lte (less than or equal), gt (greater than), gte (greater than or equal), in (in list). Example: filter=record_date:gte:2025-01-01,record_date:lte:2025-12-31

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to sort by. Prefix with minus (-) for descending order. Example: sort=-record_date,security_desc

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Options: json (default), csv, xml.

items.docs: Retrieve Daily Treasury Statement (DTS) data showing the daily cash receipts and disbursements of the U.S. Treasury. The DTS is published on every business day and provides insight into the federal government's cash position.
